stepTitle: A hydroelectric power facility converts the gravitational potential energy of water behind a dam to electric energy. What is the gravitational potential energy relative to the generators of a lake of volume $$50.0\,\text{km}**3$$ and mass $$5.00\times10**{13}\,\text{kg},$$ given that the lake has an average height of $$40.0\, \text{m}$$ above the generators?
